name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A link preview card that springs out from its trigger and staggers its contents in.

useCases: Profile mentions, linked repositories, and glossary terms that preview more detail without leaving the page.
limitations: Only direct children of HoverCardContent stagger; wrap pieces that should arrive together. Touch devices never open the card, so the trigger must work as a plain link and the card must not hold the only copy of important content.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. The trigger renders a link, so give it an href or a render element. Opens after openDelay on mouse hover or keyboard focus and closes on Escape or an outside press. Reduced motion shows and hides the card instantly without the stagger.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/hover-card.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
